title: Super Bowl XLVII
overview: Super Bowl XLVII, played on February 3, 2013, at the Mercedes-Benz Superdome in New Orleans, saw the Baltimore Ravens defeat the San Francisco 49ers 34-31 in a thrilling game filled with drama, momentum shifts, and controversy. The victory gave the Ravens their second Super Bowl title in franchise history, while the 49ers, led by head coach Jim Harbaugh and quarterback Colin Kaepernick, were left to rue missed opportunities.
